1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea perenne, con grandes hojas finas, flores de color rosa y tallo rojizo sin pelos; sus hojas tienen propiedades medicinales. (Asteraceae; Eupatorium spp.).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial herbaceous plant with large, thin leaves, pink flowers, and a reddish stem without hairs; its leaves have medicinal properties. (Asteraceae; Eupatorium spp.)
